title: Rav Nachumi bar Zechariah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Abaye, as we find that he asked [questions] of Abaye ([Shabbat 127a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.127a.4); [Eruvin 102a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.102a.10)), and he spoke in Abaye's name ([Beitzah 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.16a.14-15), [16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.16b.6)). And in [Bava Kamma 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.25b.5) Ravina said to Rav Acha of Difti: "Rav Nachumi bar Zechariah already raised this objection to Abaye." His colleague, we find, was Mar son of Ravina (whom Hyman identifies as Ravna), in [Shabbat 136a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.136a.4) and Keritot 15b (compare [Keritot 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.15a.25)), where Mar son of Ravina said: "I and Rav Nachumi bar Zechariah explained it."[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman identifies Mar son of Ravina with Ravna (רבנא; also vocalized Rabbana). This is his identification, not an independent identity resolution.

בעי מ־ means asking a question of someone; רמא ניהליה means raising an objection. תרגמינא here reports their joint explanation, rather than a future promise to translate. The references retain Hyman’s folio sides.

Beitzah cites Nachumi in Abaye’s name and records opposite rulings about porridge in the argument on 16a. Bava Kamma 25b reads Rav Nachman bar Zechariah. The joint explanation by Mar son of Ravina and Nachumi is explicit in Shabbat. Keritot 15a also names Nachumi but calls the other speaker Mar son of the Rabbis. Heilprin proposes Mar son of Ravina there. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2635&lang=en).
